Coverage_Description: Cancer medical reimbursement for carcinoma in situ and cancer, covering diagnostic tests, hospitalization/outpatient treatment, chemotherapy/radiotherapy/targeted/hormonal therapy,; per covered cancer limit up to HK$2,000,000 and lifetime limit up to HK$6,000,000 (plan-dependent), with guaranteed lifetime renewal
customer requirement: must be attached to a basic plan; underwriting required
additional informations: 90-day waiting period; excludes pre-existing cancer/related conditions; includes annual discounted cancer screening (1 test/year) and second medical opinion service (max 3 times per plan)
